eduloans.title: EduLoans
eduloans.summary: From a student conversation to an inspectable lending pre-check. One project, with separate interfaces for intake, operations and callable policy.

decisions.title: Human review is a product boundary
decisions.text: Student intake, partner handoffs and reviewer inspection share a case. Uncertain documents and unconfirmed thresholds remain visible before a reviewer acts.

decisions.title: Give AI a tool contract, not lending discretion
decisions.text: The MCP prototype exposes nine typed tools over stdio: profile evaluation, score explanation and institution lookups. The rule engine owns the answer; an agent calls a defined capability.

decisions.title: Keep versions inspectable
decisions.text: The interaction prototype, Supabase matching implementation and MCP server are separate experiments. Their source is grouped here without implying one connected production system.

mechanism.label: Documented MCP scoring
mechanism.note: University, academics and co-applicant components. Deterministic pre-check; the lender retains the credit decision.

eduloans.status: Original interaction prototype — sample data; scripted responses. MCP and matching code are prototypes. Archived March 2026 validation records 145 assertions; not rerun here and includes mocks.

theya-audio.title: THEYA.Audio
theya-audio.summary: Turn a document into a two-voice listening experience, with explicit choices about retrieval, dialogue and speech synthesis.

decisions.title: Separate what is said from how it sounds
decisions.text: Typed sentence records carry display text, speech text, speaker, voice and pauses. Extraction, dialogue generation and speech rendering are separate stages.

decisions.title: Make the model path explicit
decisions.text: Provider adapters in source cover Qwen2.5-72B, Gemini 2.0 Flash, Llama 3.3 via Groq and GPT-4o-mini for dialogue. Speech routes to Edge Neural or Kokoro-82M through Hugging Face/fal-ai. Each path needs provider configuration.

decisions.title: Retrieve before answering; inspect the checks
decisions.text: Overlapping document chunks live in SQLite. BM25, TF-IDF cosine and bigram scores retrieve passages. Grounding, term coverage and dialogue checks are heuristic diagnostics; displayed scores are not measured model accuracy.

mechanism.label: Source architecture
mechanism.expression: document → retrieval / dialogue → speaker turns → TTS → streamed audio
mechanism.note: Optional provider integrations exist in source; no inference quality or latency benchmark is claimed.

theya-audio.status: Original 2-Voice RAG Studio interface with synthetic dialogue input. Backend, model and audio services disabled for this preview.

voice-screening.title: Conversational screening
voice-screening.summary: Carry a campaign’s questions into a voice session, then turn the conversation into structured campaign records.

decisions.title: Preserve context across the call
decisions.text: A Supabase function initiates the Twilio call. A TwiML handler and WebSocket bridge connect it to ElevenLabs conversational AI with campaign context.

decisions.title: Extract after the conversation
decisions.text: A separate function calls Gemini 2.5 Flash through the Lovable gateway with a structured extraction schema. The prototype also maps recommendations into candidate statuses; those assignments have not been validated as hiring decisions.

mechanism.label: Documented call path
mechanism.expression: campaign → Twilio → ElevenLabs session → Gemini extraction → stored record
mechanism.note: The UI and integration code are inspectable. No hiring accuracy or completed-call benchmark has been established here.

voice-screening.status: Original React dashboard with synthetic records. No calls, candidate data or model services connected.

images.caption: Original dashboard · sample records; telephony and AI services disabled.

rocket-card.title: Rocket Card Finder
rocket-card.summary: Compare cards against spending patterns, fees and eligibility inputs, with the savings calculation visible at the decision point.

decisions.title: Ask about spending before ranking
decisions.text: The questionnaire captures category spending; the interface separates total savings from net savings after fees.

decisions.title: Keep comparisons actionable
decisions.text: Bank, network, fees and category filters sit beside card comparison. The source calls BankKaro UAT APIs; the isolated preview disconnects them and shows the original spending-input journey.

mechanism.label: Implemented product journey
mechanism.expression: spending inputs → calculation API → savings response → comparison
mechanism.note: Calculation depends on the service. No LLM integration was located; lender eligibility and product benefits require verification.

rocket-card.status: Original React interface · illustrative spending input; financial APIs disabled. MoneyControl branding is part of the source UI; an organizational relationship is not established.

equity-simulator.title: EquitySim
equity-simulator.summary: Make liquidation preferences tangible: change an exit value and see what remains for a common shareholder.

decisions.title: Show the consequence immediately
decisions.text: Exit value, funding, preference multiple and ownership feed one payout and a doughnut allocation chart.

mechanism.label: Implemented simplified model
mechanism.note: Preference-first common pool illustration. Excludes preferred conversion, dilution and tax; not a complete cap-table waterfall.

equity-simulator.status: Working browser tool · illustrative inputs; calculations run locally.

json-atlas.title: JSON Atlas
json-atlas.summary: Turn a JSON example into TypeScript interfaces, Python dataclasses or Go structs, without sending the document anywhere.

decisions.title: Infer once, render three ways
decisions.text: A recursive walk records object shapes in a type registry. Language-specific emitters produce code from the shared structure.

mechanism.label: Compiler-style pipeline
mechanism.expression: JSON → parse → infer structure → type registry → TS / Python / Go
mechanism.note: Example-based inference, not schema validation. Array inference begins with the first item; mixed-array unions need review.

json-atlas.status: Working browser tool · local parsing and code generation; no model/API required.

images.caption: Original tool · fictional example JSON and generated output.

regex-matcher.title: Magic Text Matcher
regex-matcher.summary: Make a regular expression readable through its effects: edit the pattern and watch matching text light up.

decisions.title: Shorten the feedback loop
decisions.text: Pattern, flags and source text stay on one screen. Match highlighting updates in place instead of asking the reader to inspect raw offsets.

mechanism.label: Matching loop
mechanism.expression: pattern + flags + text → matchAll → escaped highlight overlay
mechanism.note: Non-overlapping capture highlights; nested-group rendering is limited. Browser regex rules apply.

regex-matcher.status: Working browser tool · text stays in the tool; no backend or AI inference.

images.alt: Magic Text Matcher original live pattern editor and highlighted email matches
images.caption: Original tool · fictional email examples.

csv-streamer.title: StreamCSV
csv-streamer.summary: Transform a local CSV into downloadable JSON, with file progress visible as chunks are read.

decisions.title: Read incrementally, expose the limits
decisions.text: The browser decodes chunks and updates processed-byte progress. Output rows accumulate in memory before download.

mechanism.label: Transformation pipeline
mechanism.expression: file stream → decode → split rows → JSON chunks → Blob
mechanism.note: Simple comma splitting; quoted CSV fields are unsupported. Incremental input does not mean constant-memory output.

csv-streamer.status: Working browser tool · local file processing. Screenshot uses 250 synthetic rows; no large-file benchmark.

images.alt: StreamCSV original conversion interface after processing a synthetic CSV
images.caption: Original tool · 250 synthetic rows; no performance benchmark.

colour-palette.title: Colour palette generator
colour-palette.summary: Generate five colours in one gesture and copy a hex value directly from its swatch.

decisions.title: Keep the interaction in the colour
decisions.text: Space generates a palette; a swatch copies its value. Independent random draws provide variety rather than a claimed colour-harmony model.

mechanism.label: Per-swatch generation
mechanism.expression: floor(random × 16,777,215) → hexadecimal → pad to six digits
mechanism.note: Procedural colour exploration; no AI or perceptual-harmony algorithm.

colour-palette.status: Working browser tool · Space to regenerate; select a swatch to copy.

tv-surf.title: TV Surf
tv-surf.summary: Recreate channel surfing with a small curated video library, random starts and a brief tuning transition.

decisions.title: Let discovery feel like a remote control
decisions.text: Up/down controls wrap through channels. A random selection and start offset change what the next channel reveals.

mechanism.label: Original interaction logic
mechanism.expression: channel ± 1 → wrap → random video + start offset → tune
mechanism.note: The isolated preview demonstrates channel controls only. Third-party video playback is disabled; inspect the source for the original embed integration.

scrambl.title: Scrambl
scrambl.summary: A daily word challenge with a shared seed, a ten-second clock and a result designed to be compared.

decisions.title: Make randomness reproducible
decisions.text: The local calendar date seeds the pseudo-random generator. The same date produces the same 18-word sequence.

mechanism.label: Daily puzzle construction
mechanism.expression: YYYYMMDD → seeded PRNG → shuffled 18-word sequence → 10s rounds
mechanism.note: Local-calendar seed; not a server-synchronized global midnight. No model calls or account required.

scrambl.status: Working browser game · keyboard and on-screen letter controls.

images.caption: Original game · daily word sequence.

portfolio.title: This portfolio
portfolio.summary: A Next.js publishing system connecting source-backed case studies, original media, public repository discovery and a CV request flow.

decisions.title: Keep the evidence attached
decisions.text: The work registry preserves case routes, media and source qualifications. GitHub discovery groups related repositories while retaining each source link.

decisions.title: Treat publishing as a system
decisions.text: Server-rendered pages, canonical metadata and a sitemap make work discoverable. CV requests are recorded before the exact uploaded PDF is delivered.

mechanism.label: Publishing flow
mechanism.expression: authored registry + public repositories → grouped pages → accessible media
mechanism.note: Public GitHub data only. Private repositories and backend credentials are excluded from this showcase.
